newsitem.title: USA: Fed added via $1.0 billion customer RPs earlier.
newsitem.headline: Fed added via $1.0 billion customer RPs earlier.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves via a round of $1 billion customer repurchase agreements earlier Wednesday.
Fed action wasn't widely expected. Analysts figured that operations the past week sufficiently took care of the small add need in the first half of the current two-week maintenance period.
Federal funds were at the 5-1/4 percent target rate when the Fed entered the market, edging up to 5-3/8 percent by the end of the session.
